Profil, sejarah, visi, dan misi Sanggar: Profile, history, vision, and mission of Sanggar Seni Cakra Aji, a space for preserving traditional and contemporary music in Tulungagung.
From a single sound,
a space grows.
Pada tahun 2020, saat saya semester 5 di: In 2020, when I was in my fifth semester at ISI Surakarta, a thought crossed my mind:
\"Kabupaten Tulungagung memiliki potensi: "Tulungagung Regency has very rich artistic potential and extraordinary human resources across generations, from the younger generation to the seniors. Every year, Tulungagung also regularly holds various competitions, especially in karawitan."
Namun, di balik besarnya potensi tersebu: However, behind this great potential, a concern arose. Many kendang players are talented, but their memory of kendang patterns is limited to each individual song.
Begitu pula dengan para pesinden yang be: Likewise, the pesinden (female vocalists) are not fully prepared when presented with various types of gendhing spontaneously, as they tend to have to memorize first before performing them.
Setelah dicermati, kendala utamanya terl: On closer inspection, the main obstacle lay in the learning method. At that time, there was no studio or arts forum in Tulungagung that applied a structured and systematic learning method, from beginner to advanced level, covering practice, theory, and a comprehensive understanding of art concepts.
Berangkat dari keprihatinan tersebut, sa: Driven by this concern, my colleagues and I took the initiative to establish Sanggar Cakra Aji.
Tujuan awal kami sederhana namun mendasa: Our initial goal was simple yet fundamental: to provide a structured and systematic forum and means of arts learning, so that participants can become skilled, competent karawitan artists with a deep understanding both theoretically and practically.
Menciptakan ruang edukasi dan pembinaan: To create a space for education and talent development in the arts, especially karawitan, in order to form a future generation of young artists who are competent theoretically, practically, and conceptually, and who can apply the essential values of karawitan such as manners, ethics, and etiquette in daily life.
Melestarikan Budaya: Menanamkan rasa cin: Preserving Culture: Instilling students' love and care for traditional Indonesian arts, especially karawitan.
Mengembangkan Bakat & Potensi: Menumbuhk: Developing Talent & Potential: Nurturing students' interest, talent, and intelligence in the art of karawitan.
Membentuk Karakter & Kedisiplinan: Melat: Building Character & Discipline: Training punctuality, ethics, courtesy, responsibility, and solidarity among one another.
